## Full companion stack

First git-published milestone of the full Health Companion platform (phone + API + web + watch).

### Added
- **Injury tracking** — cases (type, body area, exercises) + daily pain 0–10
- Web **Injuries** page + Compose / mobile `+` entry flows
- Care visits, sport sessions, weight logging, **pump notification** sync
- Samsung Health / Health Connect **Energy Score**
- Auth (JWT), household device scoping
- Daily report **email**, shareable **PDF** links, AI day debriefs
- Kubernetes deploy under `k8s/` (public-safe secrets)

### Note
The 1.5.x line continued with later patches after this milestone tag (TIR settings, i18n, icons, etc.).

### Security
- Env templates use placeholders only; deploy requires `REGISTRY_PASS` from the environment

See CHANGELOG.md and k8s/README.md.
